decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line closely aligned with the firm's core modular, design-led lighting range and supported by its broad catalogue strategy, the LED track spotlight is likely to be retained absent any sign of weak market acceptance.

The LED ceiling luminaire fits the firm's established offer for attractive, adaptable general lighting and, given the growing industry and the firm's emphasis on durable customer relationships and product breadth, it is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
